If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can agree on it together. Otherwise I'll stick to the plan and won't take anything before 8.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
